notes: No text layer; all four pages were read from the image. The pages are A3 sheets scanned with the right edge cut off, so the full date, the ICU-days box and the late-night columns are partly missing. Sheet dates are read as 7/11 (pages 1-2) and 8/ (pages 3-4); the year 26 comes from the device insertion dates. The admission start date (5 Nov 2026) is not on these pages: it is taken from the admission order in F4 (global page 48) so that the encounter key matches F3 and F4. The encounter ref is the number printed on the patient label on page 3; F4 page 48 confirms it is the I.P. number. Vitals are plotted marks and are approximate. 'Inj. Advent' and 'Inj. Pan' are brand or short names as written; no doses appear. The left-edge strip of pages 1 and 3 shows hours 5 to 7 of the facing vitals graph (SpO2 98% entries) and was not extracted separately. The procedure finding duplicates the planned left bipolar hemiarthroplasty recorded in F4.
